lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in three primary vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin insertion, with the mid-column containing four distinct local maxima of approximately 15-20 pixel diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to shadowed ventral pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, sub-circular indentation or lesion is visible in the upper-mid flank region, approximately equidistant between the fifth gill slit and the vertical center of the visible frame.
other_distinctive_markers: The area immediately posterior to the gill slits exhibits irregular, elongated luminance patterns ('marbling') that deviate from the standard circular blob morphology seen further posterior.
